capability.howSuccessIsMeasured: Hidden tests compare each answer to the key (case-insensitive, whitespace and trailing period ignored), require the citation set to match exactly, and require `insufficient` to be set exactly when the corpus has no answer.
capability.name: Grounded question answering
capability.whatIsTested: Grounded question answering over a small document collection. Some documents are current, some are superseded versions, some are unrelated. The model must answer only from the corpus, cite exactly the supporting sources, and say when the corpus does not contain an answer.
capability.whyItIsDifficult: The failure mode this exposes is confident fabrication and mis-citation: answering from a superseded document, citing a document that does not support the answer, or inventing an answer for a question the corpus cannot answer. Rule 4 of the exam calls the last one its worst failure.

note: This descriptor states what the exam measures and how its published result can be checked. It deliberately does not carry the material an exam would have to ship to be reusable.
